small-games.title: Minesweeper
small-games.summary: Minesweeper on a Sundered floor. The first stone is always safe, and you never have to guess.

small-games.title: Nonogram
small-games.summary: Picture logic puzzles by candlelight. 240 hand-drawn pictures and a daily, one folio from our novel The Cistern Heresy. Never a guess.

small-games.title: Sudoku
small-games.summary: Sudoku under two moons. 480 boards and a daily, one answer each, never a guess.

small-games.title: Lanternward
small-games.summary: Light every street of Veldrenmar. An Akari logic puzzle with 300 graded levels and a daily, one solution each, never a guess.

small-games.title: Borrowed Ink
small-games.summary: A little stamp, a sheet of paper and thirty ink-exchange puzzles. Match the pattern and leave the stamp empty.

small-games.title: Sliding Puzzle
small-games.summary: The 15 puzzle on a keeper's ward-tablet. Ten measured boards per size and a daily — every board tells you its shortest way home.

small-games.title: Block Fit
small-games.summary: A warding tablet broken into shards. Forty-eight tablets and a daily — every one proved to fit back together exactly one way.

small-games.title: Tetromino
small-games.summary: The falling-block puzzle by the published rules, in a Korthen descent shaft. Marathon, Sprint and Ultra — and a top ten where every place is a replay you can watch.

small-games.title: Mahjong
small-games.summary: Mahjong solitaire on a warden's counting table: thirty hand-built layouts, a best time on each, and every deal proved solvable before it is dealt. No shuffle button, because it never needs one.

small-games.title: Match Three
small-games.summary: A match-three gem swapper on a Korthen cutting bench — and the chutes above every column show the next three stones, so a cascade is something you build rather than something you were handed.

small-games.title: Solitaire
small-games.summary: Klondike on a warden's counting table: 120 shuffled deals, each solver-proved from its opening layout, with Draw 1 and Draw 3 tables, unlimited undo and a gentle hint when the ward goes quiet.

small-games.title: Bubble Shooter
small-games.summary: Aim carved glass wards through an Aurensh observatory: real bank-shot previews, thirty-six proved chambers and a shared daily vault.

small-games.title: Snake
small-games.summary: Steer a ward-serpent across a Sundered cistern floor: three chamber sizes, walls of stone or walls of seam-light, and six public boards of ten.
